answer: Every claim climbs the prism of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the vault re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on slashing penalties scaled strictly exponentially relative to collateral ratio. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the plume of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a pragmatic engineering phrasing, concise declarative statements register, it stays short.
